running_experiment: V13 B1 remains untouched. Its RT/RD results may be reused only with exact input/W0/H0/native-writer/planner/runtime/evaluator identity.
purpose: Separate native-writer-aware target generation from writer replacement and tracking removal.
initial_panel: Same fixed first100, W0/H0, all eligible layers and native profile; one B1 per endpoint, no automatic sequential expansion.

endpoints.source: existing V13 RT if identity matches

endpoints.write: native mean ridge, direct stored D as R
endpoints.source: existing V13 RD if identity matches

endpoints.write: same native mean ridge, direct planned R

contrasts.RT_vs_RD: target/tracking policy at same frozen v12 plan
contrasts.V12_RD_vs_V14_RD: execution-aware planning and its necessary coupled optimization at fixed native writer/direct policy
contrasts.RT_vs_V14_RD: combined method effect, not pure planner ablation

cost: If qualified RT/RD outputs are reusable, only one additional B100 fit is needed. Otherwise prepare one shared v12 fit and one v14 fit; no automatic reruns or new task authorized by this design file.
frozen: same A/C0/H0 and native ridge coefficient
shared requested-relative radius .75 and v12 requested penalty
same EfficiencyAdam coordinate convention and max25/24 work
same evaluation denominators and TF ACC definitions
transparent_changes: v14 subject injection becomes context-specific actual writer action
v14 full coupled gradient and common terminal candidate
v14 no permanently frozen request or stale accepted z
technical_checks: runtime-contract.json qualification, then exact accepted payload/native writer/observer audit
scientific_success: better deployed PS and strict ACC at acceptable NS under same fixed requested budget
plan/solve-RHS exact contract, no unbudgeted inherited correction
writer energy and update norms interpreted alongside task results
reports: paired raw RS/PS/NS and strict ACC with full denominators
same-R mean response ratio distribution, not final-z percent
future_retention: Only a separately authorized sequential run can support lifelong retention/locality claims; no 2k execution is granted here.
